steps.content: No matter how many Corruptors you beat, new enemies keep being summoned endlessly.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's not working, all attacks against its body are useless. It definitely can control the laws in the Black Ring with its will.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: As long as we're in this Black Ring, we can't beat it.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We can't defeat it within the Ring, but we can't break the Ring if we don't defeat it. Aren't we trapped in a ******* dead end then?!
Perhaps it's the long fight, the light from the Ring, or perhaps you're really exhausted, your mind begins to drift, and you hear a voice you shouldn't be hearing.
Humans have no way of eliminating a Black Ring once it has appeared.
It's the worst timing to recall what he's said. You can't help but begin doubting yourself.
Does this kind of fight really make sense? Will the Sinners die here? Have you let your emotions get the better of you and made the wrong decision?
To resist Mania, you must have an extremely rational mind. Losing control of your emotions only brings contamination.
If he only followed rationality, then... why did he save you after the Ring appeared? Did that make any sense? What can you do in the face of a Black Ring that has appeared?
You see something that I can't. If what you see is hope... Then go and fight, and I'll protect you.
If that's what he believed... then you believe in yourself too. You are the one who's saving your Sinners...
With this thought, your shackles slowly begin burning, and you hear that voice guiding you again.
Come on, do it right now...
You clench your hands and try to grip the burning shackles in your palms, grasping your last connection to her. This is something only you can do.

options: It's not you whom I'm trying to defeat!
